purpose: Measure authoritative event/process/state-transition throughput while checking deterministic ordering and accepted invariants.
seed_policy: Fixed recorded seed set; repeated runs must use identical antecedents.

workload_parameters.scale: parameterized; no product-scale claim before measurement

duration_contract.value_source: Iteration count is recorded in each benchmark result and versioned with the workload parameters.

instrumentation_contract: Record tracing/profiling configuration and quantify instrumentation overhead when it materially changes throughput.
